data.name: About_Paragraph1
data.value:
Whatever the work may be, when done with care, it becomes art. I approach my craft with this philosophy.
I believe every problem can be solved elegantly in C#, and I take pride in the solutions I build.

data.name: About_Paragraph2
data.value:
As an energetic engineer, I prioritize delivering quality work on time and have strong experience writing clean, high-performance code.
Tightly engineered CI/CD pipelines are my core safeguard for keeping the systems I build running smoothly in production.

data.name: About_Paragraph3
data.value: When needed, I take end-to-end ownership and work independently, always keeping long-term goals in sight.

data.name: Resume_Subtitle
data.value:
From fintech payment systems to legacy code modernizations and IoT hardware integrations, I design and modernize mission-critical systems using .NET and event-driven architectures.

On the platform side, I build self-hosted and cloud-native infrastructure with Kubernetes, Docker, and Ansible.
I keep production environments secure, observable, and always up (99.9%+).

I care deeply about the human side of engineering.
I take pride in leading hiring processes and gladly mentoring junior colleagues as they grow into proficient engineers.
